test.create_query: CREATE TABLE volume_reducing_functions (key UInt64, s String, fs FixedString(64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO volume_reducing_functions SELECT number, randomPrintableASCII(100), randomPrintableASCII(64) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE subcolumns_push_down (key UInt64, tup Tuple(a UInt64, b String), data JSON, arr Array(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY key
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO subcolumns_push_down SELECT number, (number, randomPrintableASCII(100)), toJSONString(map('k0', toString(number), 'k1', toString(number % 7), 'k2', toString(number % 11), 'k3', toString(number % 13), 'k4', toString(number % 17), 'k5', toString(number % 19), 'k6', toString(number % 23), 'k7', toString(number % 29), 'k8', toString(number % 31), 's', randomPrintableASCII(50))), [randomPrintableASCII(10), randomPrintableASCII(10), randomPrintableASCII(10)] FROM numbers(10000000)
